summary.text: Dean Kaufert is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Assembly representing District 53, based in Neenah, elected to the Assembly in 2024.
He previously served in the Assembly from 1990 to 2012 and was mayor of Neenah from 2014 to 2022, and he chairs the Committee on Corrections.

paragraphs.text: Kaufert was born in Outagamie County, Wisconsin, on May 23, 1957, and is married with two children and seven grandchildren.
He graduated from Neenah High School in 1975 and received EMT certification from Fox Valley Technical College in 2010.
He is the owner of the Dome Sports Bar & Grill and a former owner of All Sport Trophy & Engraving.
The Legislature's page says he was elected to the Neenah City Council from 1985 to 1991, to the Assembly from 1990 to 2012, and as mayor of the City of Neenah from 2014 to 2022.
He is a member of the Winnebago County Republican Party and a former member of the Neenah-Menasha Optimist Club, the Neenah-Menasha Elks and the Fox Cities Chamber of Commerce board of directors.
This term he is vice-chair of the Committee on Ways and Means and also serves on the Financial Institutions and Local Government committees.
